The new analysis reinterprets prior evidence as 'overstated' rather than identifying new information that contradicts prior assessments. The recent call (2026-01-28) contains no new information that contradicts the prior assessment — it repeats the same architectural points (modularity, metrics inconsistency, synthetic users, automation).
